quote: The apparent viscosity of TSP solutions showed a Newtonian plateau at low shear rates, and became shear thinning at high shear rates and more concentrated concentrations.

claim_boundary: 2% w/v context from same paragraph; heat resilience not constant hot viscosity.

quote: Furthermore, during the heating-cooling process, the two apparent viscosity curves coincided well, indicating the good thermal resilience of TSP.

claim_boundary: Do not extrapolate to retort/UHT/long holding.
